patches.scope: Button (set 10:2) — added an `Icon` INSTANCE_SWAP property across all variants.
patches.change: Added a set-level INSTANCE_SWAP property `Icon#10:5` (default: Favorite glyph, key abc123...) bound on every Button variant so consumers can swap the leading icon from the properties panel without detaching. Seeded preferredValues with the 6 most-used glyphs.
patches.consumerImpact: Additive + non-breaking — existing instances gain the new property at its default. No rebind required; swap per-instance as needed.
patches.qa: Render-verified the swap on a temp instance; Gotcha #27 binding audit clean (0 unbound color); property resolves on all variants.
